name: Pocket Sec / CommLink Mk II / personal network node

description.value:
Your everyday comm-computer (street: Pocket Sec / corp: CommLink / sci: personal network node) - the term the Wired chapter leans on. This is what most Edgerunners carry as their daily driver into the Matrix.

  • Item Tier: T4
  • Availability: 4
  • Cost: ¥500
  • Profile: The standard runner's phone-computer-node. Runs your Matrix persona; holds up to 2 program mods.
  • Mod slots: 2
  • Tags: Wired

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
